check: The file 'applied.diff' must exist and be a valid unified diff format.
The diff must contain exactly one hunk (i.e., exactly one '@@' header line).
The applied diff must not contain any lines starting with '+' or '-' that are not part of the single selected hunk (i.e., no extraneous changes from other hunks).
The diff must be applicable to the original file without errors (e.g., `git apply --check` succeeds).
